one_line_summary: MAC-11’ shows PXRD_phase_transformation_in_water = 1.0 dimensionless for H2O

key_insights.title: Mechanism
key_insights.body: 1D channel along c axis; 3D rob network built from Zn2(dmtrz)2 dimers → porosity

key_insights.title: Design Rule
key_insights.body: [positive] add additional acid during synthesis to obtain phase-pure MA-11 → phase-pure MA-11 is obtained instead of a side-product crystal structure

key_insights.title: Comparison
key_insights.body: MAC-14 under heating vs MAC-11 under heating: winner=subject_a on temperature-induced PXRD peak shift near 2θ ≈ 4.6°

key_insights.title: Failure
key_insights.body: [performance_regression] omit additional acid during MA-11 synthesis: a side-product crystal structure forms instead of phase-pure MA-11

notable_quotes: MAC-13 has the largest listed pore size among the three materials at 7.8 Å, versus 5.9 Å for MAC-11 and 6.9 Å for MAC-14.
MAC-14 is an accessible porous framework along c axis and can be described topologically as a 6-connected pcu-type network.
Heating affects MAC-14 less than MAC-11: MAC-14's PXRD peak shifts only from ~4.6° to ~4.9°, much smaller than in MAC-11.
